The '''Imperial News Network''' was the public service news agency that operated under the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] sometime in [[44 ABY]]. As part of the transition from a [[oligarchy]] into a full [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]], the agency was independent from any and all forms of [[Politics#Republic|government]] censorship and charged with the oversight of all the activities of both the [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] and the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]].

==History==
As the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] transitioned [[oligarchy|power]] to a fully into [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] system, with an [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|election]] was held in [[44 ABY]] for a fully elected [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]], [[Jagged Fel]] signed a charter which gave a massive endowment to the INN which allowed it to continue its operations for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] while also granting it independence from any and all forms of government censorship. The INN was then charged to keep an eye on all the activities of both the Head of State and the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] so as to insure the swift reforms in the Imperial Remnant.<ref name="apocalypse" />
